Mike H: RC created — build rc-2026-03-22-2 sha=abc123def. Target promo window today 16:00 PT. Release notes: https://redwood.ai/notes/rc-2026-03-22-2. Need quick signoffs (canary + rollback thresholds).
DeployBot: artifact pinned: api-server@abc123def, web@abc123def. CI smoke checks passed.
Jess: smoke on staging ✅ (10m). KV warm completed, embedding cache primed.
Carla: telemetry quick-look — nothing obvious. Core evals show no regressions. I'll keep a 15m watch during canary.
Diana: +1 from product. Request conservative canary: 5% for 15m. Rollback if 5xx > 0.5% over 10m OR p95 latency +200ms. Also request annotating release notes with known fallback behavior.
sheriff-anna: I'm oncall for the window, available for rollback. Add me to incident channel if thresholds trip.
Mike H: plan: canary 5% (15m) -> 50% (15m) -> 100% (30m). Pin artifact tag `rc-2026-03-22-2`. Rollback runbook: `./scripts/rollback.sh --service api-server --to stable` (keeps DB migrations sticky).
Jess: useful quick checks: `curl -fsS https://api.prod/health | jq .` and `journalctl -u api-server -n 200`. KV warm logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/kv-warm.log`.
DeployBot: Promo scheduled at 2026-03-22T23:00Z (16:00 PT). Canary cfg applied: [5% 15m] -> [50% 15m] -> [100% 30m]. Auto-rollback policy set: 5xx>0.5% (10m) OR p95>200ms (10m).
Carla: copying release notes into docs and adding a short blurb for support. Slack announcement draft ready.
Mike H: pin applied: `artifact:api-server@abc123def` -> prod tag `rc-2026-03-22-2`. Any objections? Speak now or quiet for 10m.
Jess: :thumbsup: smoke still green.
Diana: no objections, proceed. I'll be watching product KPIs during ramp.
DeployBot: prechecks pass, KV warm checkpoint reached, alert runbooks attached. Watchers: @sheriff-anna, @Carla, @Mike H.
Mike H: final: kicking promotion now. Reminder: rollback command in ChatOps: `/ops rollback api-server`. If we hit the rollback criteria, deploybot will pause and notify this thread. Good luck. :rocket:
